scope: Bind the published Sędzia CI public key to the existing explicit sedzia-ci slot without accepting the temporary Brat alias or claiming an unrun measurement

tests.expect: The exact key artifact at output commit 18f5ea47c0a53bf72a6fc62f705ff37dcb223749 decodes to Ed25519 keyid fc5df253a482079e
The published key is mapped to domain sedzia-ci only when owner-admitted as BRAUN_SEDZIA_CI_PUBKEY, with lineage prefix sedzia-ci-run-
The current BRAUN_BRAT_PUBKEY label in the external key file is recorded as a temporary integration defect and is not evidence of Brat provenance
Workflow code commit and output commit remain distinct and immutable in the evidence record
Key-generation run success is not upgraded to MEASUREMENT, DSSE, EFFECT or full M14 GREEN
Connector public-raw readability is recorded separately from unproven production-host egress
Mutable branch inputs, unpinned actions/dependency, write permission and unproven branch protection remain explicit residuals
